request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Findings so far**", "2": "The interaction features failed.", "3": "Combining three-month gains in hourly pay and average hours produced a slightly negative, insignificant IC.", "4": "Pairing a standardized stock rate with a rising flow rate covered only half the sample.", "5": "Its sign also flipped between low and high index regimes, which points to instability rather than a conditional effect.", "6": "The best lead is the six-month change in V03 relative to V02.", "7": "Its pooled IC was small and positive.", "8": "However, its HAC t-statistic of 1.99 missed my preregistered threshold of 2.0, so it is formally falsified.", "9": "Most of its strength sits in low-index periods.", "10": "After only four attempts, treat it as tentative."}, "hypothesis": "Twelve-month log hourly-pay growth unusually high versus each group's trailing three-year history signals tightening demand not yet priced, predicting higher next-month relative returns; rolling baselines adapt to structural shifts better than expanding ones.", "expression": "csrank(tsz(lchg(V05,12),36))"}
